name: Here In Paradise
source:
As your kingdom gets attacked and your life is on the line, you suddenly wake up in another world where everything is unknown for you.

[From [url=https://nyanitus.itch.io/here-in-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你的王国遭到攻击，你的生命岌岌可危时，你突然在另一个世界中醒来，那里的一切对你来说都是未知的。

[来自[url=https://nyanitus.itch.io/here-in-paradise]itch.io[/url]]
